recentItems.title: Raiders Name Kirk Cousins Their Starting QB + AFC West Predictions | The NFL Report
recentItems.description:
On today’s The NFL Report podcast, Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak talks about the decision to name Kirk Cousins the team's starting quarterback and what their plans are for first overall pick Fernando Mendoza. NFL Analyst Gregg Rosenthal joins the show to breakdown what to expect from the Raiders based on this news.
We’ll also hear from Falcons general manager Ian Cunningham on why they kept four quarterbacks on their roster and the Vikings general manager Nolan Teasley on their plans for backup quarterback J.J. McCarthy going forward. Gregg Rosenthal also shares his predictions for the AFC West.
